about: Closing years of the spaces on the atlas. Every entry is taken from the record's own text (institutions.json), never from a guess: the record says the space closed for good, or has been closed since a date with no reopening on record, and names the year. A closure for renovation, a strike, a season or a closed branch is not entered. year_closed is null when the record says the space closed and gives no year. tools/attach_closures.py writes year_closed and closed_note into institutions.json.
